## Features
- Snow flocked pre-lit garland for indoor or outdoor display

## Information
Bring a snowy festive feel to your home with this Christow Snow Flocked Pre-Lit Christmas Garland. Available in 6ft and 9ft sizes, it’s beautifully illuminated by LEDs to add a magical glow to doorways, banisters, windowsills, and fireplaces. Switch the LEDs from warm white to multi-coloured to create the perfect festive mood, with a battery-powered design and built-in timer for easy display. Colour Switch LEDs & Light Effects Switch from warm white to multi-coloured LEDs to set the perfect festive mood. From gentle fades and twinkles to colour-changing displays, choose from a variety of light effects, with a memory chip remembering your last setting. Realistic Snow Flocked Style Crafted with flocked dual-toned PVC needles, the garland captures the look of real snow-dusted foliage for a magical wintry look. Soft tapered tips add texture and depth for a full, natural finish, creating a stunning frosted backdrop for the LEDs. Battery Powered with Timer Powered by an IP44-rated battery pack, the garland can be displayed indoors or outdoors without worrying about plugging it in. A built-in timer conveniently switches the LEDs on at the same time every evening, then turns them off six hours later. Loops for Easy Hanging Durable metal loops on both ends make the garland easy to hang around doors, banisters, fireplaces, and more. Coloured green to blend with the foliage, the loops also make it easy to tie more than one garland together for a longer display.
